storyBible.premise: She built the man everyone now admires, but the moment he entered the rooms that mattered, he left her outside them.

betrayer.name: Adrian Vale
betrayer.wound: needs emotional safety but worships status
betrayer.cowardiceVector: cannot publicly choose the woman he privately depends on

storyBible.betrayalEngine: he uses Lina's devotion privately while publicly aligning with Selene

chapterPlan.title: The Night He Named Someone Else
chapterPlan.hook: Lina hears Adrian thank Selene in front of investors.
chapterPlan.mainBeat: public displacement at a launch party
chapterPlan.endingBeat: Lina realises she is being erased in public

chapterPlan.title: A Place Card Without Her Name
chapterPlan.hook: A dinner card assigns Lina to the staff table.
chapterPlan.mainBeat: elite family manners cut deeper than insults
chapterPlan.endingBeat: Selene thanks Lina like hired help

chapterPlan.title: The Dress Code
chapterPlan.hook: Lina is told black tie means old money, not effort.

chapterPlan.title: The Version He Presents
chapterPlan.hook: Adrian introduces Lina as an operations consultant.
chapterPlan.mainBeat: their private history is stripped away
chapterPlan.revengeProgression: Lina saves evidence instead of arguing
chapterPlan.endingBeat: someone mistakes Selene for the woman behind the company

chapterPlan.title: An Invitation Forwarded Late
chapterPlan.hook: The board meeting invite reaches Lina after decisions are made.
chapterPlan.revengeProgression: she starts talking to a rival investor
chapterPlan.endingBeat: Adrian says it was simpler this way

chapterPlan.title: The Smile Selene Saves for Witnesses
chapterPlan.hook: Selene praises Lina in a tone that keeps her beneath the room.
chapterPlan.revengeProgression: Lina quietly refuses another unpaid rescue
chapterPlan.endingBeat: the product demo fails without her

chapterPlan.title: What He Asks For in the Dark
chapterPlan.hook: Adrian begs Lina for help after midnight.
chapterPlan.revengeProgression: she gives less than he expects
chapterPlan.endingBeat: he reaches for her only when no one can see

chapterPlan.title: Withdrawal
chapterPlan.hook: Lina leaves one task undone and the company trembles.
chapterPlan.humiliationProgression: room notices her worth too late
chapterPlan.endingBeat: Adrian hears her name from people who never saw her before

chapterPlan.title: A Different Door Opens
chapterPlan.hook: An investor invites Lina to build elsewhere.
chapterPlan.endingBeat: Selene realises Lina is leaving with leverage

chapterPlan.title: What They Called Taste
chapterPlan.hook: Lina repeats their own language back to them in a cleaner room.
chapterPlan.endingBeat: Adrian is made to wait outside her meeting

previousChapterSummaries: Lina is publicly displaced by Adrian at a launch party and realises she has no name in the room that uses her work.
At a rich-family dinner Lina is seated and spoken to like help, while Adrian lets the insult stand.
An elite dress code becomes another way to remind Lina that effort cannot buy inheritance.
